 Michigan Football Injury Report: Week 9 at Rutgers
 The final injury report was just released for Michigan Football vs Indiana. Here is the update on Blake Frazier, Dom Nichols, Rod Moore and others:
 by Von Lozon Oct 31, 2026, 2:36 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 We are two hours out from the Michigan Wolverines taking on Rutgers, which means the final injury report has officially been released. Here are all the injury details you need to know.
 Out
 WR Kendrick Bell 
 CB Jo’Ziah Edmond 
 WR Braydon Alford 
 RB Micah Ka’apana 
 DE Julius Holly 
 OL Ace Hamilton 
 OL Andrew Sprague 
 Game-time decision
 Edge Dom Nichols 
 DL Enow Etta 
 Edge John Henry Daley 
 After being listed as questionable all week long, a pair of safeties in Rod Moore and Jordan Young are nowhere to be found on the injury report, so they will be good to go for today’s game.
 Also listed as questionable all week, once again, were edge rushers Dom Nichols and John Henry Daley. Unfortunately, they are both — along with another defensive lineman in Enow Etta — listed as game-time decisions. If for some reason one or multiple of those guys are out today, look for guys like Jonah Lea’ea, Tariq Boney and others to step up along the defensive line.
 Finally, the Wolverines have some relatively good news along the offensive front. Center Jake Guarnera has been probable all week due to a lingering injury issue, but he isn’t on the final injury report of the week, so h e will be able to suit up and play against the Scarlet Knights this afternoon. The same goes for linebacker Troy Bowles, who was also probable all week long.
 Kickoff is set for 12:30 p.m. on Big Ten Network.
